cohort: A single female patient carrying a HUWE1 likely pathogenic variant.
finding: In a patient with a HUWE1 likely pathogenic variant, prenatal ultrasound showed borderline ventriculomegaly, rotated cerebellar vermis, and dysgenetic corpus callosum, while postnatal MRI identified a short/thin corpus callosum, falcine sinus persistence, reduced cerebellar vermis size, wide inferior IV ventricle, and reduced pontine bulging.
